questions.question: Differentiate between insertion at the beginning and at the end of a linked list.
questions.solution_html:
• Beginning insertion adds a new node before the first node and updates the head pointer.
  • End insertion adds a new node after the last node and updates the last node link.
  • Traversal - Visiting elements one by one.
  • If operator is found, pop required operands.
  • Complete Binary Tree

questions.solution_html:
• elements are stored linearly even though they are logically arranged in rows and
  • columns.

  • all elements of the first row are stored followed by the next rows. In column-major order

  • elements. Give explanation.
